description: Defines the Storage class and related functions for managing memory storage in the c10 namespace, including constructors, accessors, and utility methods.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Represents a memory storage object with various constructors and methods for managing memory buffers.

methods.name: create_legacy
methods.description: Creates a legacy storage object for a given device.

methods.name: reset_legacy
methods.description: Resets the storage to an empty state.

methods.name: set_nbytes
methods.description: Sets the number of bytes in storage.

methods.name: resizable
methods.description: Checks if the storage is resizable.

methods.name: nbytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the storage in bytes.

methods.name: sym_nbytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the storage as a SymInt.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the data.

methods.name: mutable_data
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the data.

methods.name: mutable_data_ptr
methods.description: Returns a reference to the mutable DataPtr.

methods.name: data_ptr
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the DataPtr.

methods.name: set_data_ptr
methods.description: Sets the data pointer and returns the previous DataPtr.

methods.name: set_data_ptr_noswap
methods.description: Sets the data pointer without swapping.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type of the storage.

methods.name: allocator
methods.description: Returns the allocator used for the storage.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the storage.

methods.name: unsafeReleaseStorageImpl
methods.description: Releases ownership of the internal StorageImpl pointer.

methods.name: unsafeGetStorageImpl
methods.description: Returns the internal StorageImpl pointer.

methods.name: getWeakStorageImpl
methods.description: Returns a weak intrusive pointer to the StorageImpl.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the storage is valid.

methods.name: use_count
methods.description: Returns the reference count of the storage.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Checks if the storage is uniquely owned.

methods.name: is_alias_of
methods.description: Checks if this storage is an alias of another.

methods.name: UniqueStorageShareExternalPointer
methods.description: Shares external pointer with the storage, only if uniquely owned.
